meta.title: Computer Networks — Sample Exam
meta.subject: Computer Networks
meta.source_note: Written by hand for testing. Not generated from real course files.
notes: Sample pack: 10 questions, 3 topics, one True/False question.

questions.question: A small office wants its computers to use one shared printer and exchange files. What is the main reason a network helps here?

options.A: It makes each computer physically larger
options.B: It lets devices communicate and share resources
options.C: It removes the need for operating systems
options.D: It stops devices from talking to each other

questions.explanation: A network exists so devices can communicate and share resources like printers and files. The other options describe things a network does not do.

questions.question: Which device forwards frames inside a local network by looking at MAC addresses?

options.A: A hub, which repeats every frame out of all its ports
options.B: A modem, which links the office to the internet provider
options.C: A router, which forwards packets between different networks
options.D: A switch, which sends frames only to the port of the destination MAC

questions.explanation: A switch learns which MAC address sits behind each port and sends frames only there. A hub repeats frames to every port, and a router works between networks.

questions.question: A company links its offices in two different cities. Which kind of network covers this distance?

options.A: A WAN, which spans large geographic areas
options.B: A LAN, which stays within one building or campus
options.C: A PAN, which connects devices within a few meters of one person
options.D: A WLAN, which connects devices wirelessly in a local area

questions.explanation: WAN means wide area network, built to link sites that are far apart. A LAN stays inside one building or campus.

questions.question: In a star topology, what happens to the rest of the network if one cable between a computer and the central switch is cut?

options.A: All computers lose connection because the cable is shared by everyone
options.B: The network keeps working only if the cut computer was first in the chain
options.C: Only that computer loses connection and the others keep working
options.D: The central switch reroutes the signal through a neighboring computer

questions.explanation: Each computer in a star has its own cable to the switch, so one cut affects only that computer. A shared single cable is how a bus topology works.

questions.question: Which statement best separates a MAC address from an IP address?

options.A: A MAC address is written as four numbers separated by dots
options.B: A MAC address identifies the network card, while an IP address identifies the device's place on a network
options.C: An IP address is burned into the network card at the factory
options.D: Both identify a device in exactly the same way

questions.explanation: The MAC address belongs to the network card. The IP address tells where the device sits on a network. Option C swaps the two.

questions.concept: Device can have MAC and IP
questions.question: A device can have both a MAC address and an IP address.
questions.explanation: They work at different levels, so one device normally has both.

questions.question: A laptop joins a home Wi-Fi network and receives the address 192.168.1.25 automatically. Which service most likely handed it out?

options.A: DNS, which turns names into addresses
options.B: NAT, which translates private addresses to a public one
options.C: DHCP, which hands out IP settings automatically
options.D: ARP, which maps an IP address to a MAC address

questions.explanation: DHCP gives devices their IP settings when they join a network. DNS looks up names, NAT translates addresses, and ARP maps IP to MAC.

questions.question: A video call app cares more about speed than about perfect delivery. Which transport protocol fits best?

options.A: UDP, because it sends data without waiting for acknowledgments
options.B: TCP, because it guarantees ordered and reliable delivery
options.C: ICMP, because it carries web pages quickly
options.D: HTTP, because it is the transport protocol for all web traffic

questions.explanation: UDP skips acknowledgments, so live audio and video arrive with less delay. TCP is reliable but waits to resend lost data. HTTP is an application protocol, not a transport one.

questions.question: Which list shows the OSI layers in order from layer 1 upward, for the first four layers?
questions.explanation: The order is Physical (1), Data Link (2), Network (3), Transport (4). The other lists swap neighboring layers.

questions.question: Which protocol is mainly used by a browser to request and receive web pages?

options.A: FTP, for transferring files between hosts
options.B: HTTP, for requesting and delivering web pages
options.C: SMTP, for sending email between servers

questions.explanation: HTTP is the protocol browsers use to ask a server for a web page and get it back. FTP, SMTP and SSH serve other jobs.
